## Highlights

- Look at any run of months, even across the new year. A Scope now goes from one Period to another, so in January you can see the last three months, November through January, on both Movements and Stats.
- Quick presets: Last period, Last 3, Last 6, Last 12, Year to date and Whole year. Choose Custom to pick any From and To month yourself.
- The month and year selectors always offer every month and every year, whether or not you recorded anything in them. Changing the year keeps the month you were looking at.
- Stats opens on Year to date. Its totals and spending breakdown cover exactly the months you chose, balances are shown as of the last month, and the charts show the twelve months leading up to it.
- Movements opens on the latest month with movements, and links you saved before this version still open the same view.
